title: LOK SABHA SPEAKER TO PARTICIPATE IN VISHWA SHANTI MAHAYAGYA IN VADNAGAR, GUJARAT
body_text: Honble Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla, will participate in the ongoing 10-day Vishwa Shanti Mahayagya at the historic Shri Hatkeshwar Mahadev Mandir in Vadnagar, Gujarat, on 18 November 2026. ​The grand Mahayagya, which commenced on 11 November 2026, and will conclude on 20 November 2026, is being held under the divine guidance and presence of Kanchi Kamakoti Peethadhipati Jagadguru Sri Shankara Vijayendra Saraswati Swamigal. Organized with the sacred purpose of promoting global peace, social harmony, and public welfare, the event features daily rituals, alongside 144 participating Vedic scholars and devotees from across India. *** AM
